title: Coven automation run receipt (coven.automations.receipt.v1)
description: Sealed evidence that a run reached a verified outcome under a verified binding. The digest is taken over the canonical JSON form (RFC 8785 style: recursively sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace). Redaction replaces redacted fields before digesting, so a redacted receipt verifies exactly as sealed.

bindingDigest.description: Digest of the exact authority binding (principal, familiar revision, runtime capabilities) the run was authorized under.

orchestrator.description: Which control path produced the run; direct and Psyche-orchestrated runs share one binding and receipt contract.

artifacts.description: Digests of the artifacts this run was produced against (definition, schedule vector, engine release).

digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical form of the receipt with the digest field absent.
